newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grains subdued by currency.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grains subdued by currency.

text.p: Higher LIFFE grain futures on the back of a weaker sterling choked off trading on the UK physical grain markets on Thursday.
"We knew yesterday was too good to be true, we had a good day then, but today has been very poor,'"said a trader.
Traders said another factor was the weekly European Union grain tender.
"The market is always quiet ahead of the tender, not that we expect much from it this week," said another trader.
On the export market February feed wheat traded at 99 stg, while March fetched 95 stg and April/June 96 and 97 stg, all for 2,400 tonnes fob east coast ports.
On a thin delivered market feed wheat in East Anglia traded at 94 stg for February while 98.75 and 99 stg was paid for July.
In the Avon range Jan feed wheat traded at 92.50 and 93 stg with Apr/Jun fetching 97 stg.
Feed barley in East Anglia traded at 95 and 95.50 stg for February and 98 stg for April/June.
Traders were unable to report any mill wheat business. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
